source_assumptions: Representative regular monsters only; four Turoth tiers and two normal Zygomites. No boss/superior/task/quest gates/Slayer training.
Nechryael death-spawn summons deferred. Double rare-seed roll chooses same seed at doubled quantity, rather than independent seed identities; source Snape quantity3-6 simplified to6.

Smoke Devil facemask/task requirements deferred. Sourhog goggles/unprotected20-30 and temporary stat drain deferred. Zygomite magical melee uses existing magic lane prototype; exact hybrid melee accuracy deferred.

Turoth leaf-bladed/broad/Magic Dart restrictions and rapid regen deferred consistently with Kurask. Wall Beast free-standing combat only: wall-hole trigger, grab/spiny helmet/location respawn are deferred.
Rockslug salt uses source4HP-or-less threshold; early accepted use consumes salt. Stop-retaliation at1HP, autosalt perk and brine sabre bypass deferred.

Zygomite dose is an explicit single-consumable prototype: finish below8 source HP, consume on accepted use; native ten-charge spray/refill inventory and pick-fungi transformation deferred. Fungicide loot remains a refill collectible.

Smoke Devil and Turoth multirun herbs keep source quantity mixture but same selected herb identity. Uniques treated mutually exclusive prereolls; task/quest/clue/area tertiary excluded. Members/no wealth/pre-Legends and explicit Nothing residual.
